description: Deterministic four-seat hashes from the current sim. CPU uses the existing campaign loop (seed 42, all cpu) through its terminal state. Mixed and four-local runs apply the scripted device inputs below for 1800 ticks (30 sim seconds) and do not change the campaign test.

mixedSeed7Tick1800.input: locals: right for 70 of every 100 ticks, attack every 10th tick, jump every 45th tick

fourLocalSeed99Tick1800.input: each seat: right for 70 of every 100 ticks, lane nudge from slot parity, attack when tick % 12 === slot, jump when tick % 80 === slot * 3
